name: zzzparanoidal-shipwreck
title: PARANOIDAL: start shipwreck
author: FactorioParanoidal; machines and graphics: darkfrei, sbelyakov (Looting Spaceship Wrecks); AAI wreck graphics: Earendel
description: The start crash of Paranoidal in one place: the crashed ship, its debris and the AAI wrecks with their contents and mining loot, the salvaged assembling machine, lab and ship generator. Start level setting: minimum (half of the supplies, defects), medium, rich (default: random better quality of finished items). The player starts empty; ruins keep the standard wreck loot.
